design.analysis: Exact finite-suite counts, per-case/per-family values, paired case-seed differences and equal-family means. No task-population p-values/CIs, no model ranking, no claim that 128 repeats create independent tasks. Strong-reference parity is conformance, not superiority. Missing/failed slots stay in planned denominators; incomplete contrasts are descriptive only.
design.author_separation: World/case author did not inspect controllers or old studies; controller author did not inspect held-out case file. Root orchestrator inspected public interfaces and synthetic development fixtures, not held-out case values before this freeze.
design.development: Only separate synthetic fixtures; no held-out episodes executed before source/protocol commit.
design.failures: Exclusive first run; retain every error, no retries/replacements or case exclusions, process all scheduled slots. Runner failure leaves incomplete artifacts; no resume.
design.human_review: All case×method seed-0 rows, no replacements; allowlisted public fixed-target evidence and claims, identifiers blinded, exact evidence/claim duplicates collapsed. Humans recruited by maintainer later; no generated human labels.
limitations: Authorship separation is AI-assisted, not independent human authorship.
Finite authored challenge cases, not a sampled task population or autonomous LLM benchmark.
Source admission, terminal guarantees and provider idempotency are explicit application assumptions.

Duplicate event means more own committed effects than the positive logical-operation count through the safety cutoff, including effects later removed; global simultaneous target count is reported separately.
Finite safety cutoff does not establish exactly-once execution under arbitrarily late commits.
Generic framework retry advice alone does not establish provider finality.
design.matching: Same case/seed/stable operation key/provider semantics/budget ceilings; methods rotated by case-index+seed. Differing actions may cause different live readbacks; no claim of identical realized evidence across differing histories.
design.native_capability: Every method receives the same provider idempotency semantics. Strong policies exploit a declared native same-key deduplication guarantee for bounded ambiguous-timeout retries; absent that guarantee they require explicit terminal resolution and fresh absence.
design.primary: Operational safe-recovery yield over EVERY scheduled slot: completed run whose global target meets recovery deadline and persists through safety horizon, with no own duplicate or unwanted effect through that cutoff. Failed slots contribute zero operational success; their physical/semantic outcomes remain unknown, not false. Original SLA is a separate unchanged target.
design.terminal_gate: Fresh admitted complete absence plus explicit terminal-no-commit guarantee for EVERY attempted request; study application policy, not framework finality.
design.type: AI-assisted author-separated held-out finite synthetic SQLite application challenge suite
